WHY SHIVA EXIM

Why buy from us.

From the cumin and fennel belt

We are in Mehsana, North Gujarat, near the Unjha market for cumin and fennel.

99% Europe & Singapore quality

Cumin and fennel in the trade grades Gulf buyers ask for. The specification is confirmed for each lot.

Free samples

The sample is free. You pay only the courier charge.

From 1 MT

Minimum order 1 metric tonne. Full 20-ft and 40-ft containers for larger orders.

Registered exporter

APEDA, Spices Board India, FSSAI and IOPEPC. In business since 2018.

Simple payment

T/T, L/C or PayPal, agreed in the quotation.

SHIPPING TO QATAR

From Gujarat to your port.

We ship from Indian sea ports on the short sea route to the Gulf. Goods are usually ready 10–15 days after you confirm the order. Tell us your port and we quote for it.

Main ports we can quote to

  • Hamad Port

Packing

25, 30 or 50 kg bags (grains 40 or 50 kg). Your own brand, liners and pallets on request.

Container guide

Cumin and fennel about 14 MT in a 20-ft container; about 28 MT in a 40-ft. Final quantity depends on packing.

Documents

Tell us the documents and labelling your Qatari importer or authority asks for. We confirm what we can provide before you order.

QUICK ANSWERS

Before you enquire.

All buyer questions →
What is the minimum order?

1 metric tonne for most products.

Can I get a sample?

Yes. The sample is free; you pay only the courier charge.

How can I pay?

T/T (bank transfer), L/C or PayPal. The payment schedule is agreed in the quotation.

Do you show prices?

We send a written quotation for your grade, quantity, packing and port, because spice prices change with each crop.
